name: Proof Bakery
tagline: Sourdough, pastry and seasonal fruit, baked through the night on Mill Street.
hours_note: Closed Mondays. We close early when the shelves are empty.
order_note: Call by 2pm the day before for whole cakes, tarts, and bread by the dozen. We'll have it boxed and waiting at the counter.

menu_sections.name: Bread
menu_sections.note: Naturally leavened, fermented for two days

menu_sections.name: Cakes & tarts
menu_sections.note: By the slice, or whole with a day's notice

art_direction.identity: A framed bakery broadsheet: bone canvas inside hairline borders, square corners, no cards and no rounded photos. One cherry-red band carries the bakery's short name in giant serif letters, and a cocoa footer closes the page.
art_direction.type: Gloock (display serif, weight 400 only) for the wordmark, headings, bake times and prices; Schibsted Grotesk for everything else. No third family.
art_direction.color: One accent: cherry red (bg-primary). It paints the hero band, the oven times, prices, and the Order ahead buttons. Everything else is bone, flour-sack surface and cocoa ink. Never add a second color.
art_direction.signature: The oven board — what comes out of the oven and when, typeset like a departure board with the times in red. It lives in the Bakes collection; keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Early-morning plain speech. Times, ingredients and names of farms over adjectives. No exclamation points, no puns about dough.
